ModMetaData.name: Default White Lights
ModMetaData.author: Cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
Electric lights default to white instead of orange. Optionally set a colour per room type; newly built lights use that room's colour.
Use Mod options to change the global default, enable room colours, and apply the current colours to lights already on the map.
The in-game colour picker and Ideology darklight toggle still work.
